notes: הַדְּבָרִים הָאֵלֶּה: the phrase's one determiner is the *these* written for the demonstrative pronoun, so both articles are `unrepresented` — the shape rule 41 records for הַמָּקוֹם הַהוּא → *that place*.
The article of הַיּוֹם takes the written *this* under rule 41, no demonstrative pronoun standing in that phrase to claim it.
